features.text: THERAPEUTIC STRETCH SUPPORT: Provides static-dynamic tension to improve range of motion and reduce contractures.
CUSTOM-MOLDABLE SHOULDER BASE: Heat-formable component ensures secure, personalized shoulder fit.
ADJUSTABLE ANGLE CONTROL: Up to 30° adjustment delivers gentle, constant stretching.
FLEXIBLE UPRIGHT STRUCTURE: Moves naturally with patient muscle reactions while maintaining support.
TARGETED REHABILITATION: Designed specifically for torticollis, muscle spasms, and lateral neck contracture therapy.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
